about.label: Master technician
about.name: U Win Naing Swe
about.bio: For more than 35 years, U Win Naing Swe has stood at the workbench of Sein Pan Electronic, repairing tens of thousands of televisions, audio systems and power boards. He founded the shop in 1989 on a simple promise: an honest diagnosis and a repair that lasts. Every device is treated with the same patience and precision that built the shop's reputation across the city.
